summary: Landing was blank (React unmounts whole tree on uncaught error, no boundary). Added SectionBoundary per section + GlobeBoundary/Suspense + #root loading fallback. Fixed dashboard absolute link. Unused Float import removed.
root_cause: No error boundaries: any single render throw (R3F Canvas/WebGL, canvas, GSAP) unmounted entire React tree -> blank page
fixes: GlobeBoundary + Suspense around R3F globe with gradient-orb fallback
